items.title: Jaxon Smith-Njigba: Listed as limited again
items.description:
Smith-Njigba (ankle) was listed as a limited participant on Tuesday's estimated practice report, Curtis Crabtree of Fox 13 Seattle reports.

items.title: Jalen Coker: Takes part in practice Tuesday
items.description:
Coker (quadriceps) was spotted participating in the Panthers' unofficial practice session Tuesday, Alex Zietlow of The Charlotte Observer reports.

items.title: Woody Marks: Lead role awaits sans Montgomery
items.description:
Marks is expected to handle a lead role out of the backfield during Sunday's game against the Jaguars in London after Texans head coach DeMeco Ryans announced Monday that fellow running back David Montgomery (groin) is viewed as week-to-week, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: TreVeyon Henderson: Out multiple weeks with high-ankle sprain
items.description:
Henderson is expected to miss multiple weeks after he was diagnosed with a right high-ankle sprain following an MRI on Monday, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Blake Corum: Efficient with eight touches
items.description:
Corum rushed five times for 19 yards and a touchdown and brought in three of four targets for 53 yards in the Rams' 37-34 overtime loss to the Bills on Monday night.
